caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed teapot rendered in grayscale pencil within a rectangular frame on a cream-colored background. The teapot is rounded with a bulbous body, a curved spout on the left, and an arched handle on the right, which appears darker and thicker than the rest of the teapot, suggesting it might be made of a different material. The lid is dome-shaped with a pointed knob at the top. There is detailed scrollwork with a crest or emblem in the center of the teapot’s body. Reflective highlights and shading suggest a metallic surface. The name "V. CARRANO" is written in block letters in the lower left corner inside the frame. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Silver Coffee Pot
